text:
Meow Mix is the brand. Its advertising said cats "ask for it by name", which fits its "meow meow meow meow" jingle. The team note points to a "Feast" gourmet line, which would be Fancy Feast, but I don't think that's right. Fancy Feast's slogan is "Feed their fancy", not "ask for it by name". I'm going on memory and haven't looked this up.

CONFIDENCE: 88
